parameters.query:
SELECT id, reddit_id, title, selftext, score, num_comments, author
FROM app.reddit_candidates
WHERE status = 'new'
  AND author NOT IN (SELECT author FROM app.reddit_blacklist WHERE author IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH thresholds AS (
  SELECT
    (value->>0)::numeric AS min_quality
  FROM app.policy_params WHERE key='min_quality_score'
),
hthresh AS (
  SELECT (value->>0)::numeric AS min_horror
  FROM app.policy_params WHERE key='min_horror_score'
)
UPDATE app.reddit_candidates c
SET
  quality_score = $2::numeric,
  horror_score = $3::numeric,
  rejection_reason = $4,
  status = CASE
    WHEN $4 IS NOT NULL THEN 'rejected'
    WHEN $2::numeric >= COALESCE((SELECT min_quality FROM thresholds), 6.5)
      AND $3::numeric >= COALESCE((SELECT min_horror FROM hthresh), 7.0)
    THEN 'queued'
    ELSE 'scored'
  END
WHERE id = $1::int
RETURNING id, status;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='queued') AS queued,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='rejected') AS rejected,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='scored') AS scored,
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE service='openai' AND occurred_at >= now() - INTERVAL '1 day'), 0) AS daily_cost_usd
FROM app.reddit_candidates c
LEFT JOIN app.cost_ledger l ON l.occurred_at >= now() - INTERVAL '1 day';
